title: Prefect Integration
summary: This module integrates Pydantic-AI agents with Prefect for durable execution, enabling agents to run as Prefect flows and tasks for enhanced reliability and observability.

nodes.label: PrefectAgent
nodes.title: PrefectAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an existing Pydantic-AI agent to enable its execution within Prefect flows, offloading model requests and tool calls to Prefect tasks.

nodes.label: Prefectify Toolset
nodes.title: Prefectify Toolset
nodes.description: A utility function that wraps a given toolset, such as FunctionToolset or MCPServer, to integrate it with Prefect's task execution model.

nodes.label: PrefectAgentInputs
nodes.title: PrefectAgentInputs Cache Policy
nodes.description: A custom cache policy for PrefectAgent that computes cache keys by filtering out non-deterministic fields from inputs, ensuring consistent caching for durable execution.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework
nodes.description: Provides the core agent abstractions and execution logic that PrefectAgent wraps.

nodes.label: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.description: Defines the toolsets and capabilities that can be integrated and managed by agents, including those wrapped for Prefect.

groups.label: Prefect Integration Core
groups.title: Prefect Integration Core Components
groups.description: The primary components responsible for adapting Pydantic-AI agents and their tools to run within the Prefect orchestration framework.
